notes: Deploy Handle with no constructor arguments, then NameRegistry, whose only constructor argument is the deployed Handle address ($token). Neither contract has an owner, administrator or privileged wallet, and no initialization calls are required. NameRegistry charges its immutable 100 HNDL fee for each 365-day registration or renewal, and the whole fee accrues to the claimable pool. Annual rounds are permissionless: startRound takes a snapshot and processes the first batch of up to 200 names inline, so a registry of at most 200 names settles in that one call and larger ones are finished by anyone calling processSnapshot. While a snapshot is unfinished, registration, transfer and claiming are frozen, but renewal stays open so a holder can always save a live lease. claim() takes no arguments: entitlement is fixed at the snapshot and pays an equal share to each distinct address that held a live name then, whether or not it still holds one. Unclaimed shares and rounding dust roll into the next round. The pool pairs with native ETH, has no hook, and uses decimal sqrtPriceX96; its initial price is a pool parameter, not a promised market valuation. Policy-derived ownership, signed artifact linkage, independent review, admission and deployment are handled by the corresponding services.
